beats.place_detail: in the car on the drive to the school science fair
beats.event: Mia was very nervous and quiet in the car on the way to her school science fair

beats.place_detail: a school gymnasium set up for a science fair
beats.event: Mia explained her volcano project to the judges confidently and didn't place but was proud anyway
beats.quote: she was just proud she did it

panels.place: the back seat of a car
panels.action: Mia stares out the window, silent the whole ride.
panels.caption_a: Not a word out of her the whole drive.
panels.caption_b: Mia's nerves filled the whole car.

panels.action: Mia points confidently at her volcano's model.
panels.caption_a: No ribbon, but she owned that room.
panels.caption_b: Mia explained every part like a pro.

panels.place: a car on the way to school
panels.action: Mia fidgeting with her display board, saying little.
panels.caption_a: Quiet nerves all the way to the gym.
panels.caption_b: Mia barely spoke on the drive over.

panels.action: The judges nod along to Mia's explanation.
panels.caption_b: She was proud, and that was the point.
